name: Path Investments Plc
summary: Path Investments PLC, is a Principal Investment Firm. specializing in acquisitions. The firm seeks to invest in energy and oil and gas development and production companies. The firm seeks to invest globally with the focus in the Turkey. The company, through its investment in Alpay Enerji AS, holds a 100% participating interest in gas exploration licenses located in Hatay and Konya; and ARAR Petrol ve Gaz AUPAS, holds a 100% participating interest in circa 17 under-developed oil and gas exploration licenses. It also provides oil and gas services to third party license owners in Turkey and Kurdistan. The company was formerly known as The Niche Group Plc and changed its name to Path Investments PLC in February 2017. Path Investments PLC was incorporated in 2000 and is based in London, United Kingdom.
